name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the single hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) matches the task wording ('never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door'); the machine's rejecting state u3 correctly captures doing one then the other, the rule-only warning is valid since the ban is a restriction, and the environment constraint (key_lost requires door not open on the same step) does not make the clause redundant because it also forbids key_lost followed by a later door_open.

texts: Never both lose the key while the door is closed and have the door open.
